title: Business value and monetization
why: Connect technical capability to customer problems, delivery costs, and clear offers.

images.headline: Business value and monetization
images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation slide image, strictly landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is part of a matched 100-concept Data Science Masterminds Agentic Accelerator V3 APEX series. Style: Apple-inspired restraint, polished friendly 3D objects with subtle realistic studio lighting, generous negative space, deep navy background #041B36 fading very subtly to near-black #020B18, white text #F7F8FC, restrained amber #F2A541 emphasis and teal #5EC4B6 secondary details. Where analogy is used include tiny 'Analogy' label near illustration. Do not include any text beyond the specified heading, supporting sentence, labels and footer. Maintain visual consistency across series.

CHAPTER INDEX SLIDE. Override concept layout: text-led chapter opener with spacious readable typography, almost no illustration. Top eyebrow 'CHAPTER 11'. Headline 'Business value and monetization'. Supporting WHY sentence 'Connect technical capability to customer problems, delivery costs, and clear offers.'. Center and lower-middle two columns of four topic entries, exact IDs and topic names, no omissions:
085  Customer discovery
086  Use-case prioritization
087  Minimum viable product
088  Value proposition
089  Lead-generation workflows
090  Sales and CRM workflows
